name: Solace Medical Compression Therapy Gloves
description:
Graduated-compression gloves that apply precise, varying pressure across the hand and fingers to manage swelling, improve circulation, and reduce pain in arthritic or post-surgical joints. Smart-fabric elements adjust compression in real time based on embedded swelling sensors.

Worn by aging workers whose hands have been destroyed by decades of manual labor, by augmentation patients managing rejection symptoms, and by anyone whose hands hurt and who can't afford to stop using them.
functionality: Dynamic compression therapy, swelling management, pain reduction
what_it_says: Your hands are broken in ways that won't heal, but you still need them to work tomorrow.
story_hooks: A factory worker's Compression Therapy Gloves reveal abnormal swelling data patterns that don't match arthritis — something in the factory is causing a new kind of hand damage that no one has identified yet.

physical_description.visual_profile: Form-fitting medical gloves that hug the hand like a second skin, with visible graduated compression zones running from wrist to fingertips. Sleek, clinical aesthetic with subtle tech-forward details. Sits between functional prosthetic and high-end wellness wear.
physical_description.fit: Compression-fitted throughout, contoured to individual finger anatomy. Snug at wrist with graduated release toward fingertips. Allows full range of motion despite tight profile.
physical_description.primary_material: Smart-responsive synth-polymer blend with embedded sensor threads; outer layer is breathable medical-grade elastane composite with moisture-wicking properties
physical_description.texture: Smooth, almost liquid-like surface with subtle ribbed compression channels running lengthwise. Warm to touch. Micro-perforations visible under close inspection for thermal regulation.
physical_description.color_scheme: Gunmetal gray primary with bioluminescent pressure-indicator striping along knuckles and finger joints (faint blue-green glow that intensifies with swelling). Matte finish with satin accent piping at wrist cuff.
physical_description.closures: Magnetic closure system at wrist; friction-fit design requires careful donning but ensures no pressure points
distinctive_features: Embedded biometric sensors at palm and finger joints
Real-time compression adjustment visible via subtle LED accent lines
Solace Medical embossed logo on back of hand in raised tactile print
Smart-fabric memory: adapts compression profile to individual hand geometry over first week of wear
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2-3 crossover: affordable medical-grade tech, not luxury but premium functional. Accessible to working-class augmentation patients and aging laborers through corpo health plans or sub-market resale.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by factory workers, dock laborers, surgical patients, augmentation-integration patients managing rejection. Signals resilience, chronic pain management, continued economic participation despite bodily deterioration. Street credibility among those who refuse to stop working.
physical_description.condition_typical: Broken-in and well-used; compression zones show slight discoloration from sweat and wear. Bioluminescent striping may flicker inconsistently in heavily-used units. Often patched at knuckles or reinforced with additional wrapping. Rarely pristine.

image_prompt: Close-up fashion photography of Solace Medical Compression Therapy Gloves on weathered, augmented hands of a middle-aged worker. Hands positioned flat on dark industrial surface, showing graduated compression zones and faint bioluminescent blue-green accent striping along knuckles glowing softly. Gunmetal gray synth-material with visible micro-ventilation channels. Harsh overhead lighting casting dramatic shadows, cyberpunk clinic aesthetic.
